items.title: Tigresses leave for UAE to feature in Emerging Nations Trophy
items.summary: This will be Bangladesh's first appearance in the competition. The second edition of the tournament will feature 10 teams, up from eight in 2025.

items.title: No time to breathe for South Africa-bound Tigers
items.summary: Bangladesh's record in South Africa makes the challenge particularly daunting. Across eight Tests between 2002 and 2022, the Tigers have lost all eight, including five by an innings. They will begin their campaign at the Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg, where they are yet to play a Test.

items.title: Mosaddeak’s third ton helps Rangpur hold Chattogram
items.summary: Mosaddeak struck 145 off 317 balls, while Shihab James and Sams M Niloy added 52 apiece as Rangpur reached 310 for nine in their second innings, setting Chattogram a 69-run target.

items.title: Tigers off to South Africa, set for historic Wanderers debut
items.summary: The two sides head into the contest with contrasting recent results. South Africa recently secured a 2-1 home series victory over Australia, while Bangladesh are coming off a 1-0 series defeat against the West Indies at home.

items.title: Former BCB boss Bulbul appointed advisor to Lahore Qalandars
items.summary: Lahore Qalandars have appointed former Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) president Aminul Islam Bulbul as an advisor to the franchise’s High-Performance Centres.

items.title: Shanto: Bangladesh failed to make use of home conditions
items.summary: "Looking at the Test match as a whole, neither our batters nor our bowlers performed well; the responsibility lies with us"

items.title: Laurie Evans: 'My world was turned upside-down' during four-year fight against doping ban
items.summary: Batter experienced 'suicidal thoughts' after testing positive for ostarine during routine test in 2022

items.title: Dale Benkenstein appointed Bangladesh's batting specialist ahead of SA tour
items.summary: Bangladesh are scheduled to tour South Africa in November and December 2026 to play two Tests, three ODIs and three T20Is

items.title: Chase: Our improved game against spin helped us win in Bangladesh
items.summary: "We did not lose a series [this year]. This is something that hasn't been done for a number of years"

items.title: Hridoy ensures draw in Sylhet; WI beat Bangladesh 1-0 in series
items.summary: Hridoy scored 324 runs in the Test, across both innings, while Warrican claimed a four-for and a three-wicket haul

items.title: Mushfiqur becomes first Bangladesh batter to score 7000 runs in Tests
items.summary: Apart from being Bangladesh's highest run-getter in Tests, Mushfiqur Rahim is also their most-capped Test cricketer and holds their record for most Test centuries

items.title: Bangladesh call up uncapped batter Mahfijul Islam for Tests in South Africa
items.summary: Mohammad Naim and Khaled Ahmed have been brought into the squad for the two-Test series in South Africa in place of Soumya Sarkar and Nayeem Hasan

items.title: Hridoy on his 242*: You 'cannot get out of a difficult spot without counterattacking'
items.summary: Record-breaker also offered praise for the Bangladesh lower-order for the recovery from 184 for 7 to 386 in the first innings against West Indies in Sylhet

items.title: Kavem Hodge: There is a belief and shared mindset among WI batters
items.summary: Kavem Hodge scored his third Test century in Sylhet and ascribed his team's collective rise in batting form as down to belief and camaraderie within the set-up

items.title: Hridoy's historic 242* powers Bangladesh's epic turnaround in Sylhet
items.summary: Bangladesh went from 184 for 7 to 386 despite Shadman not batting, thus gaining a lead of 30 against WI

items.title: Mahmud: 'Beating a batter is quite a good feeling'
items.summary: Fast bowler believes Bangladesh can take the lead against West Indies despite being 268 runs behind after the second day's play in Sylhet

items.title: 'It's all about sticking to my strengths' - Jangoo backs his instincts after Sylhet ton
items.summary: He attributes this impressive run to an unwavering belief in his approach

items.title: Injured Shadman Islam unlikely to bat in Bangladesh's first innings
items.summary: The Bangladesh opener was taken off the field on a stretcher after injuring his ankle on the second morning of the Sylhet Test

items.title: WI seamers rattle Bangladesh, put visitors ahead in Sylhet
items.summary: Earlier in the day, Hasan Mahmud took 6 for 90, and became only the second man since Nathan Lyon to take his first five five-wicket hauls in different countries

items.title: Wickham: Jangoo was telling me what Test cricket is all about
items.summary: West Indies debutant praises his batting partner after they turned the tables on Bangladesh in Sylhet

items.title: Jangoo ton lifts West Indies after early wickets
items.summary: Amir Jangoo's second Test century, in his tenth innings, formed the backbone of West Indies' 235 for 4 in the first innings of the second Test against Bangladesh
